newsitem.title: DUBAI: Al Khaleej says to buy 200,000T raws from Phibro.
newsitem.headline: Al Khaleej says to buy 200,000T raws from Phibro.

text.p: Al Khaleej Sugar Co refinery said on Tuesday it would purchase 200,000 tonnes of raw sugar from trader Phibro for delivery from June to October.

"We've tied up with Phibro London for the purchase of raw sugar from them for shipment June to October. The tonnage is 200,000 and the origin is mainly Brazil," Al Khaleej deputy general manager for finance, Shabbir Baheranwala told Reuters.
He said the price will be based on New York futures prices and determined in due course.
Phibro is the commodities trading unit of Salomon.
